questions.stem: What does the term arthrogryposis multiplex congenita describe?
questions.answer: A descriptive label for multiple joint contractures present at birth, not one diagnosis

questions.stem: What is thought to cause arthrogryposis contractures early in development?
The commonest subgroup of arthrogryposis multiplex congenita is ____.
In neuropathic arthrogryposis, what is seen in the anterior horn cells?
questions.answer: Fewer and smaller anterior horn cells

questions.stem: Which of these conditions can also cause joint contractures like arthrogryposis?
Which other congenital anomalies can occur with arthrogryposis?
What is the incidence of arthrogryposis multiplex congenita?
Arthrogryposis often involves ____ limbs.
In arthrogryposis, what are the elbows usually like in the upper limbs?
In arthrogryposis, what is the usual lower-limb foot deformity?
What is the usual hip position in arthrogryposis?
Do contractures in arthrogryposis progress over time?
In arthrogryposis, what are the distal muscles and reflexes like?
questions.answer: Small, wasted distal muscles with absent reflexes

questions.stem: What skin features are seen over the joints in arthrogryposis?
questions.answer: Thick, tense skin with dimples; absent normal skin creases

questions.stem: What is usually true of intelligence in arthrogryposis?
Which associated features can occur with arthrogryposis multiplex congenita?
questions.answer: Micrognathia, congenital heart disease, scoliosis, cleft palate, hypoplastic lungs

questions.stem: What types of surgery are typical in arthrogryposis?
questions.answer: Orthopaedic release of contractures or deformity correction, ENT, oral surgery, diagnostic muscle biopsy

questions.stem: In arthrogryposis, which airway features may make intubation difficult?
questions.answer: Micrognathia, TMJ involvement or trismus, cleft palate, cervical spine involvement

questions.stem: What causes chronic lung disease in arthrogryposis?
questions.answer: Recurrent aspiration from dysphagia, and restriction from scoliosis

questions.stem: Why is IV access often very difficult in arthrogryposis?
In arthrogryposis, how should pressure points be managed during positioning?
Why may regional anaesthesia be hard in arthrogryposis?
